scenes.setting: Still at the club: hired to investigate himself, with five pounds up front and expenses promised — a commission too generous to refuse without suspicion, and a use for it forms at once: point the important figure at Mr. A and the Aurora Order
scenes.text_anchor: Getting me to investigate myself again?

scenes.setting: Under Saint Samuel Cathedral: Leonard lays out how he would hunt the tarot organization — reverse-search The Fool's seekers, re-list everyone from both cases, sift them with Nightmare powers — and Soest explains why it stays low priority: so far the tarot group has only helped them
scenes.text_anchor: “Perhaps they can help us discover even more unsavory matters.

scenes.setting: Half a month to the new year, a month of quiet digestion summarized: Leppard's patent granted and Framis Cage circling as investor; the Werewolf characteristic still unsold; Audrey nearly inside the Psychology Alchemists; Fors buying Deep Sea Marlin blood and writing furiously; Derrick lying low while Lovia stays locked beneath the spire
scenes.text_anchor: In the blink of an eye, there was only half a month left until the new year.

scenes.setting: Two steps back before the doorbell is answered — Mrs. Doris still healthier than she's been in ten years, telling him so for the ninth time, while Brody balances on the coat rack; today Klein needs the lawyer of the house
scenes.text_anchor: “Mrs. Doris, you’ve already told me this for the ninth time.”
